name: MCP Client
description: Connect agents to external MCP servers over stdio or Streamable HTTP. Exposes the mcp_list_tools and mcp_call agent tools. Ships with a Claude Code preset (claude mcp serve).
author: Evonic

variables.name: MCP_SERVERS
variables.label: MCP Servers (JSON)
variables.description: JSON object mapping server name to {command, args, env, cwd, enabled} for a local (stdio) server, or {url, headers, enabled} for a remote (Streamable HTTP) one, e.g. {"nuwaira-deck": {"url": "https://deck.example/mcp", "headers": {"Authorization": "Bearer nwd_..."}}}. Only admins can edit this; agents can never supply commands, only a server name. For the claude-code preset, set cwd to the directory Claude Code should operate in.

variables.name: CALL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
variables.label: Tool Call Timeout (seconds)
variables.description: Default and maximum timeout for mcp_call. An agent may pass a smaller per-call timeout_sec.

variables.name: STARTUP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
variables.label: Server Startup Timeout (seconds)
variables.description: Max seconds to wait for an MCP server to spawn and complete the initialize handshake.
